newsitem.title: USA: Focus in Japan on domestic demand growth - US aide.
newsitem.headline: Focus in Japan on domestic demand growth - US aide.

text.p: Japan's deregulation program could help its economy in the medium to long-term, but is likely to have little impact in the short-run, a White House aide said on Monday.

"It is for that reason that there is a continuing focus upon the maintenance of domestic demand-led growth in Japan," senior White House economic policy adviser Daniel Tarullo said. "That is an understanding shared by both the Japanese government and the American government," he added.

Briefing reporters ahead of this week's summit of industrial democracies in Denver, Tarullo said he did not know if Japan's budget squeeze this year would slow domestic demand growth, but noted concerns have been raised about that.
President Clinton is expected to meet Japanese Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto on the fringes of the June 20-22 summit.
